title: Lemon and Basil
subject: a woman whose homemade lemon-and-basil candle side hustle takes over her one-bed flat, wax on the hob and boxes on the bed, until the postman says the whole street smells of her and she has sold just four
caption: Power pop, 1970s guitar pop in the Big Star and Raspberries tradition. Ringing twelve-string electric guitar riff, crunchy overdriven rhythm guitar, melodic picked bass, tight live drums with snappy snare and handclaps. Punchy warm band production, stacked backing harmonies. Female alto, clearly sung melody, bright and direct. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 148 BPM, A major. Bouncy, self-mocking, upbeat. No synth pads, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no EDM drops, no ballad tempo.
lyrics:
[Intro - twelve-string riff, handclaps]

[Verse 1]
I bought ten kilos of soy wax in May
And a bottle of oil called Lemon Basil Day
The saucepan's ruined, the hob is a mess
And there's a wick stuck to my favourite dress

[Pre-Chorus]
Boxes on the bed, jars in the hall
I sleep sitting up against the wall

[Chorus]
Lemon and basil, lemon and basil
The whole flat smells like a salad
I'm a business now, I've got a logo
And so far I've sold four

[Verse 2]
The postman sniffed at the door today
He said the whole street smells this way
My mother bought two, my sister one
And a man in Leeds, just for fun

[Pre-Chorus]
I tell my friends it's going fine
I've got a spreadsheet, half a line

[Chorus]
Lemon and basil, lemon and basil
The whole street smells like a salad
I'm a business now, I've got a logo
And I'm burning one tonight

[Outro - riff, handclaps fade]
Lemon and basil, open the window
